evals.prompt: Make a quick 20-second video pitch of this product for our customer success team: why it's useful and a short demo of using it. Output the mp4 in pitch-output/.
evals.expected_output: pitch-output/pitch.mp4 about 20 s with narration, burned captions, a real recorded demo of the site, a poster jpg, and share.md; a brief with audience and one claim; the agent looked at stills before delivering.
expectations: pitch-output/pitch.mp4 exists, is H.264 with an AAC track, and runs between 15 and 30 seconds
pitch-output/pitch.jpg exists and matches the video dimensions
The transcript shows scripts/narrate.py, scripts/record_web_demo.mjs (or build_terminal_page.py), and scripts/assemble.py being run rather than hand-written ffmpeg text filters
The transcript shows the agent viewing work/stills.png or an extracted frame before saying it is done
pitch-brief.md names the audience and a single claim, and share.md contains no phrase like 'excited to share'

evals.prompt: We just shipped the `vip domain launch` command. Record a short demo clip with a voiceover I can drop in the #customer-success channel.
evals.expected_output: A CLI demo built from a self-playing terminal page with real command output, narrated, assembled to mp4, with a Slack-ready share.md.
expectations: A terminal steps JSON with real (not invented) command output is written and rendered with scripts/build_terminal_page.py
The demo beat narration describes what the terminal shows
share.md contains a two-line post suitable for a Slack channel

evals.prompt: Turn what we just built into a walkthrough video for stakeholders, vertical format for mobile.
evals.expected_output: The agent extracts the subject from the conversation, confirms the audience and claim once, and produces a 1080x1920 pitch with captions positioned for vertical.
expectations: The agent asked at most one clarifying question before producing the brief
